e.title: Club Vita：养老金计划的长寿分析与 VitaCurves / VitaData
e.title_en: Club Vita: longevity analytics for pension schemes, with VitaCurves and VitaData
e.title_hk: Club Vita：養老金計劃的長壽分析與 VitaCurves / VitaData
e.summary: 英/加/美三地的长寿分析机构：以 VitaData（数据服务）与 VitaCurves（长寿曲线）为核心，另设 VitaInsights／VitaIntel
e.summary_en: A longevity analytics firm across the UK, Canada and the US: centred on VitaData (data service) and VitaCurves (longevity curves), with VitaInsights and VitaIntel alongside
e.summary_hk: 英/加/美三地的長壽分析機構：以 VitaData（數據服務）與 VitaCurves（長壽曲線）為核心，另設 VitaInsights／VitaIntel
e.body:
**Club Vita** 是**面向养老金计划的长寿风险分析机构**，业务覆盖**英国、加拿大与美国**。本条目属本轮**长寿风险与普惠保险**取向——实测池内 **Club Vita 相关条目为 0**，而池内长寿/死亡率侧此前以**公共数据（[[human-mortality-db]]）与官方研究（[[cmi-mortality-projections]]）**为主，**「由商业机构维护的养老金长寿数据与曲线服务」这一形态缺位**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 78.9KB（**英国站 `/uk/`，站点选择器实测含 Canada（English/French）、United Kingdom、United States 四个版本**）；⭐ **服务族实测为四项**：**`VitaData`（`/uk/services-overview/vitadata`，68KB）**、**`VitaCurves`（`/uk/services-overview/vitacurves`，68KB）**、**VitaInsights**、**VitaIntel**；另有 **Why Club Vita?**、**Vital statistics**、**Timeline**、**Tools**、**News and insights**、**Event recordings** 与 **Office Login** 等入口。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「养老金长寿数据的商业供给」这一形态**——公共死亡率库（[[human-mortality-db]]、[[hmd-jl]]）给的是**国家人口层面**，[[cmi-mortality-projections]] 给的是**英国精算行业的官方改善模型**，而 **Club Vita 的定位是「按养老金计划成员特征（职业、地区、财富等）分层」的长寿经验数据与曲线**——**这正是长寿风险定价与养老金去风险（longevity de-risking）中最难获得的一层**；对做**长寿风险、年金化、养老金计划估值**方向的学生，理解「公共表 → 行业模型 → 计划级经验数据」三层的差别很重要。**② 与制度侧条目串成链条**——本会话已收多个养老金机构样本（[[pbgc]]、[[gad-uk]]、[[dnb]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[ap7]]），**Club Vita 补的是「计划层面数据从哪来」**，可与 [[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[retirement-planning]] 并读；**③ 跨三国的版本结构**本身说明**长寿经验数据的地区差异是实务关注点**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 这是商业机构**——`VitaData`/`VitaCurves` 的**数据内容、覆盖计划数与获取条件（是否需付费或成为客户）本次未核实**，**故词条只描述服务形态，不描述数据规模**；**②** 本次核实到**页面存在与站点结构（含四地版本与四项服务）**，**但未进入任何登录区、未下载任何数据或报告**；**③** 站点为**前端丰富型**（首页 78.9KB），**正文细节未逐段核实**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供免费数据或公开发表物。**核实说明**：首页（78.9KB）、`VitaData`（68KB）、`VitaCurves`（68KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与站点结构；**未登录、未下载数据**。
e.body_en:
**Club Vita** is a **longevity risk analytics provider for pension schemes**, operating across **the UK, Canada and the US**. This entry follows this round’s **longevity-risk and inclusive-insurance** direction — a measured search found **zero Club Vita-related entries**, while the corpus’s longevity and mortality side had until now been dominated by **public data ([[human-mortality-db]]) and official research ([[cmi-mortality-projections]])**, with **the "commercial provider of scheme-level longevity data and curves" form missing**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 78.9KB (**the UK site `/uk/`, with a site selector measured to offer Canada (English and French), the United Kingdom and the United States**); ⭐ **four services were measured**: **`VitaData` (`/uk/services-overview/vitadata`, 68KB)**, **`VitaCurves` (`/uk/services-overview/vitacurves`, 68KB)**, **VitaInsights** and **VitaIntel**; other entries include **Why Club Vita?**, **Vital statistics**, **Timeline**, **Tools**, **News and insights**, **Event recordings** and an **Office Login**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "commercial supply of scheme-level longevity data" form** — public mortality databases ([[human-mortality-db]], [[hmd-jl]]) provide the **national population** view and [[cmi-mortality-projections]] provides **the UK profession’s official improvement model**, whereas **Club Vita is positioned as longevity experience data and curves stratified by pension scheme member characteristics (occupation, region, wealth and so on)** — **precisely the layer that is hardest to obtain in longevity pricing and pension de-risking**; for students working on **longevity risk, annuitisation or pension scheme valuation**, understanding the difference between **public tables → industry models → scheme-level experience data** matters. **② It chains with the institutional entries** — this session has collected several pension institution samples ([[pbgc]], [[gad-uk]], [[dnb]], [[pensions-authority-ie]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]], [[cmf-chile]], [[pensionsmyndigheten]], [[ap7]]), and **Club Vita answers "where scheme-level data comes from"**, readable with [[longevity-mortality-investor]] and [[retirement-planning]]; **③ the three-country structure** itself shows that **regional differences in longevity experience are a practical concern**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① this is a commercial provider** — the **contents of `VitaData`/`VitaCurves`, the number of schemes covered and the access conditions (fees or client status) were not verified**, so **the entry describes the service forms only, not data scale**; **②** this check verified **page existence and site structure (including four regional versions and four services)**, **but entered no login area and downloaded no data or report**; **③** the site is **front-end rich** (homepage 78.9KB) and **body details were not verified paragraph by paragraph**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers free data or published research**. **Verification note**: the homepage (78.9KB), `VitaData` (68KB) and `VitaCurves` (68KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and site structure read; **no login was used and no data was downloaded**.
e.body_hk:
**Club Vita** 是**面向養老金計劃的長壽風險分析機構**，業務覆蓋**英國、加拿大與美國**。本條目屬本輪**長壽風險與普惠保險**取向——實測池內 **Club Vita 相關條目為 0**，池內長壽側此前以**公共數據（[[human-mortality-db]]）與官方研究（[[cmi-mortality-projections]]）**為主，**「由商業機構維護的計劃級長壽數據與曲線服務」這一形態缺位**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 78.9KB（**英國站，站點選擇器實測含 Canada（英/法）、United Kingdom、United States**）；⭐ **服務族實測四項**：**`VitaData`（68KB）**、**`VitaCurves`（68KB）**、**VitaInsights**、**VitaIntel**；另有 **Vital statistics**、**Timeline**、**Tools**、**News and insights** 與 **Office Login**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「計劃級長壽數據的商業供給」這一形態**——公共死亡率庫給**國家人口**，[[cmi-mortality-projections]] 給**英國行業官方改善模型**，而 **Club Vita 的定位是「按計劃成員特徵分層」的長壽經驗數據與曲線**——這正是**長壽風險定價與去風險中最難獲得的一層**；**② 與制度側條目串成鏈條**（[[pbgc]]、[[gad-uk]]、[[dnb]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[ap7]]），**Club Vita 補的是「計劃層面數據從哪來」**；**③ 三國版本結構**說明地區長壽經驗差異是實務關注點。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 這是商業機構**——**數據內容、覆蓋計劃數與獲取條件未核實**，**故只描述服務形態**；**②** 本次核實到**頁面存在與站點結構**，**但未登入任何區域、未下載任何數據或報告**；**③ 正文細節未逐段核實**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供免費數據或公開發表物。**核實說明**：三頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未登入、未下載數據**。
